pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: IF IT AIN'T THE GOLDEN CHILD. NEVER SEEN YOU IN THE SUNSHINE BEFORE.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: GOT TO CATCH HIM IN THE DAYLIGHT.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: OLD FARTS IN THE REST HOME TURN IN EARLY.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: HEY! HOW MANY TIMES HAVE I TOLD YOU TO SHOW SOME RESPECT!

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: YOU CALL HIM "MISTER," YOU CALL HIM "PAPA DINO."

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: YOU DON'T GET OUT OF MY WAY MARVIN.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ...AND I'M NOT GONNA CALL HIM AT ALL.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: ...HEY.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: HEY, ASH.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: Y’KNOW, I USED TO BE A BIG FAN OF YOURS.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: HEY, YOU EVER GONNA MAKE ANY MORE MOVIES? I THINK YOU’RE STILL YOUNG ENOUGH.

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: DIRTBAG.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: WH- WHAT WAS THAT?!

pages.speaker: character1
pages.text: ISAID THAT YOU WERE A DIRTBAG MARVIN.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: BUT I WAS THINKING THAT YOU WERE ALSO A FAT PIG.

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: I'LL KILL YOU, YOU LITTLE-

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: EASY, MARVIN, EASY!!

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: PUNK...

pages.speaker: character5
pages.text: JUST A PUNK...

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: FUCKING.. IF HE WASN'T PAPA'S PET I'D..I'DF- FUCKING...

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: JESUS CHRIST, MARV, PULL YOURSELF TOGETHER! HE'S JUST A GODDAMN KID!

pages.speaker: character3
pages.text: “KID”? OH, YEAH... THAT’S ALWAYS BEEN HIS ACT. JUST A KID, RIGHT.

pages.speaker: NARRATION
pages.text: LEMME TELL YOU, THOUGH.. ONE FINE DAY I SWEAR I’M GONNA SNAP THAT WORTHLESS LITTLE QUEER’S NECK.
